bubble.intro: Pop as many bubbles as you can!

toss.intro: Tap to toss the chip into the cup!

dance.intro: Tap the glowing animal to the beat!

breath.intro: Let's fill the balloon with slow breaths. Hold the button and breathe in. Let go and breathe out.
breath.hint: Hold the button while you breathe in. Let go to breathe out.
breath.quick: 🐢 Try a slower breath in. Hold until the balloon is big!
breath.endDetail: You took 5 slow breaths. Slow breathing helps when you feel upset, worried or wiggly.
breath.sayDone: Well done. You took five slow breaths. You can do this any time you need to feel calm.
